candidates.change_summary: Replace nonReentrant_ modifier body to omit resetting locked_ to false after function execution, causing lock to remain set after first use.
In Put, set acc.unlockTime to the lesser of provided _unlockTime and block.timestamp instead of the greater, changing stored unlockTime after Put.
In Put, do not update acc.balance (delete the balance addition), so stored balance after Put differs.

Replace the external call to msg.sender.call with a transfer-style state update first: decrement acc.balance before performing the external call (changes reentrancy outcome and final acc.balance after Collect).
Delete the external call entirely and instead only update internal state and log (no Ether sent), changing observable balance and funds flow.
Modify the nonReentrant_ modifier to disable the lock (remove the require), allowing reentrancy which can change final balances after Collect.
